_about: The matching model, in one place. Identity is (account, date, cents) plus these windows, and each is a choice with a reason. A witness pairs only inside its window; outside it, it stays a question. The engine reads these; nothing is a magic number in code.

transfer.why: Bank-to-bank transfers settle within a few business days.

wage.why: A deposit can land before or after the pay date.

settle.why: T+2 plus a weekend and a public holiday.

pending.why: A hold posts or drops within a week.

date_drift.why: A statement dates by transaction, a download by posting.

tax_result.why: A refund follows its assessment within weeks.

receipt.why: A receipt and its card line.

childcare.why: Gap fee debited after the statement.

policy.why: A premium paid around the start of its period.

similarity.why: Two descriptions of one line share at least a quarter of their words.
